title: Russian Missile and Drone Attack Hits Kyiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk Regions
detail: Overnight Oct 29-30 Russia launched four Kh-59/69 guided missiles, 113 drones (Shahed, Gerbera, Parodiya decoys) and ballistic missiles of unspecified number. Ukraine's Air Force says 3 of 4 Kh-59/69 missiles and 96 drones were downed or jammed; drone hits at 17 locations, debris at five. A separate attack on Kyiv killed one person and injured another in the Dniprovskyi district. Single-outlet reporting (Ukrainska Pravda); casualty figures not independently confirmed.
